subject: Pilot readiness and senior intro — coordinate deep dive
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@celectra.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-22T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery — pilot fit

Thanks for the call earlier — good conversation. Wanted to capture next steps from our side and book the senior technical intro (VP/CTO) you suggested. Key items we need to validate before a pilot: 

- Network/VPC requirements and outbound egress patterns (security wants to review)
- Data retention & audit log retention options (compliance)
- Expected latency and cost range for 10–20 concurrent users

Samir (Head of Infra) and I can join the senior call. Our VP of Eng, Caleb, also wants to participate for the architecture discussion. Are you able to: 

1) Share a short pilot plan and a straw SOW we can review internally?
2) Propose two 60‑minute slots next week for VP/CTO intro + infra deep dive?

Appreciate it — aiming to get procurement and security syncs aligned by end of next week.

— Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Product
Celectra

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-04-22T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery — pilot fit

Thanks Elena — great to hear the team is lining up stakeholders. Quick responses inline and next steps: 

- Pilot plan & straw SOW: attaching a condensed pilot plan and a SOW template to iterate from. The plan focuses on a 4‑week pilot (ingest → integration → 1 pilot app), with clear success metrics and a rollback path.
- Senior intro slots: we have these high‑probability windows next week (all PT):
  • Tue 2028‑04‑24 09:00–10:00
  • Tue 2028‑04‑24 15:00–16:00
  • Wed 2028‑04‑25 08:30–09:30

Karthik will be leading the technical run‑through and Ben (solutions engineer) will cover the cost/throughput expectations. If you confirm one slot I will send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Attachments: redwood-pilot-plan-v1.pdf, SOW-terms-template.docx

Proposed agenda (45–60m):
- 5m intros + goals
- 20m infra + networking deep dive (Karthik)
- 15m latency/cost and model variants (Ben)
- 10m open Q&A + next steps

If security wants a pre‑call checklist, I can include a one‑pager for them to review before the meeting.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (555) 732‑1184

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. The pilot plan looks reasonable at a glance. We can do Tue 04/24 15:00–16:00 PT. A couple of asks from Infra/Sec so your team can prepare: 

- Can Karthik include the expected outbound IP ranges and whether a static egress NAT is required for the private deployment option?
- For audit logs: what retention granularity do you support (per-request metadata vs aggregated metrics)?
- Do you have a short diagram of where model weights are hosted during Dedicated vs Private?

I'll accept the invite once it's sent. Caleb will join for the first 30m and then may triage to a senior engineer depending on flow.

— Samir

Head of Infrastructure
Celectra

Perfect — slot locked for Tue 2028‑04‑24 15:00–16:00 PT (calendar invite sent). 

Prep notes for the call (attached as a one‑pager and pasted below):

[Attachment: redwood-call-prep-onepager.pdf (6 KB)]

Quick prep summary:
- Network: we’ll bring the egress options (static NAT, NAT pool, and VPC peering patterns).
- Audit logs: we support request‑level logging with configurable retention windows; we’ll share default retention tiers and export options (S3/KMS).
- Hosting diagram: single slide comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (weights location + encryption at rest).
- Pilot kickoff checklist: sample success criteria and a short procurement timeline.

Agenda will be sent in the invite; I’ll plan to record the session and share slides afterward. If you want us to redact anything from the SOW before it goes to procurement, flag the sections and we’ll iterate.

See you Tuesday — thanks for moving quickly on this.

Best,
Marissa
